extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of a Cheltenham estate worth around £736,500 (mainly the deceased's home, with little cash) asks about borrowing £48,500 for professional fees and tax pending the sale of the property.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for the Cheltenham estate; we have passed it to our team for review. To take it further, we would need confirmation of the grant of probate position, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities, details of any inheritance tax due and when, and confirmation of the executors' identities and consent. It would also help to have the property valuation and an indication of the marketing or sale progress, along with the fee estimate the £48,500 is intended to cover. We cannot comment on terms, rates or availability at this stage. A member of the team will come back to you once the information has been reviewed.
